tasks.name: Latency benchmark
tasks.result: 223/223 eval tests, typecheck clean. Ran the FULL real 20-briefing benchmark (not scaled down) against real Ollama, concurrently with the background eval job. REAL MEASURED RESULT: AC-1 FAILS both halves -- P95 total 254,501ms vs <60,000ms target; P95 first-token 254,393ms vs <5,000ms target (n=20, measured while contended with the concurrent eval job, disclosed as such). Attribution: retrieval/assembly/citation-gate stages are all <1% of runtime; generation (LLM decode) is ~100% of the failure. 20/20 runs hit the 30s generation budget and were truncated; 19/20 produced 0 accepted claims because the deadline passed before the first token arrived. First paint (pending items, zero LLM calls) stayed <1ms across all 20 runs -- the OI-1 property that path exists to guarantee held throughout, reported as its own row, never conflated with first-token.
